evidence.quote: I cut speed to reduce squat and shifted our track toward the deeper water on the outer edge of that stretch.
evidence.explanation: The pilot combines two adjustments into a real-time revised course of action to resolve a clearance shortfall without abandoning the tidal window, showing non-routine problem resolution and contingency planning.

evidence.quote: When I heard a harbor tug not originally assigned was nearby, I requested that one instead of waiting on our delayed second tug.
evidence.explanation: The pilot improvises a substitute resource plan under changing wind conditions, demonstrating adaptive, non-routine solution generation.

evidence.quote: I chose a graduated correction rather than aborting, applying tug and thruster power progressively and watching the response.
evidence.explanation: The pilot designs a staged corrective maneuver with a built-in abort contingency, reflecting planning under uncertainty toward a goal.

task_anchors.task_description: Reconciling conflicting depth/tide information via independent vessel-specific sounding, then adjusting speed and track.
Selecting a maneuver (slow and shift track) in response to an unmoved barge obstruction under time pressure.
Substituting an unassigned nearby tug for a delayed assigned tug as wind conditions worsen.
Executing and monitoring a graduated corrective maneuver during final berth approach with cross-current, retaining an abort contingency.
